gizmo.title: Kusanthula zowerenga
gizmo.description: Ophunzira amaika mbendera pa ziganizo, ndime kapena zithunzi m'nkhani zomwe zili umboni wa chizindikiro chilichonse, kapena amasankha gawo lomwe likuyankha bwino kwambiri funso.

configure.title: Ntchito
configure.description: Ikani mbendera pa umboni: ophunzira amamata mbendera iliyonse pambali pa umboni wake. Sankhani chimodzi: ophunzira amasankha gawo limodzi lokha lomwe likuyankha bwino kwambiri funsoli.

configure.title: Ophunzira amasankha
configure.description: Zomwe wophunzira amaloza m'nkhani. Zithunzi zitha kusankhidwa nthawi zonse.

configure.title: Mbendera
configure.description: Zizindikiro zomwe ophunzira amaika. Gwiritsani ntchito Lembani mayankho mu menyu ya chipika kuti musankhe komwe chilichonse chikuyenera kukhala.

configure.title: Nkhani yowerenga
configure.description: Nkhani yomwe ophunzira amagwiramo ntchito. HTML iliyonse: mitu, ndime, mindandanda ndi zithunzi.

configure.title: Njira yopatsira maksi
configure.description: OER Schema: njira yopatsira maksi pa mayeso awa (mwachitsanzo mfundo, chilembo, peresenti, kumaliza).

configure.title: Cholinga cha maphunziro
configure.description: OER Schema: cholinga cha maphunziro chokhudzana ndi mayeso awa.

configure.title: Maphunziro
configure.description: OER Schema: maphunziro omwe mayeso awa akukonzedwera.

advanced.title: Zoyesera
advanced.description: Kangati wophunzira angayang'ane. 0 amatanthauza zopanda malire.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani funso ili ngati mzere womwe umatsegulidwa ndi kutsekedwa. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika oyandikana nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani yopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikapindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umangowonetsa funso ndi momwe lilili.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso loperekedwa kuti ligwiritsidwe ntchito m'malo oyendetsedwa ndi xAPI pozindikira chinthuchi
